title: RUGBY IN SEASON
author: Reese F.
desc:
This training in the weight room will help you stay in shape and in good health to make sure your muscles are good to go when you finally get out to the Saturday game
￼

ex.note: RDL into a Deep Squat Into a Crowpose then push up with hands above your head
Side to side is one rep
Incorporate two warm up sets

ss.note:
Elevated on legged hammy bridge. 
Place a bench/box and put on leg slightly bent and hold and pulse for the rep count then switch legs

Go for every 30 seconds

Side groin plank 

Place one leg on a box/bench hold for 15s switch legs and that’s one set

ex.note: Alternating legs up down with both is one rep
Front arm reach plank

Scrum plank roll out

Grab a weighted bar that rolls get in scrum position or on knees and roll out then squeeze coming back

First Set is on a bench 
Second set is with your chest on the floor
Third Set push up position right hand right brow touch opposite elbow with elbow then extend out
Fourth: Y position bench stretch

ss.note: Isolation of the arms do not curl body when slamming the ball
On your knees. Control weight coming down explode going up
Place a band on the bar and have a bar stopper so you can focus on explosion
Heavy weight
Seated put a bar stopper exploded up max power and place bar on holders before exploding into the next rep

ex.note: Scrum plank roll out
Front arm reach ten each side
Scrum plank roll out
Alternating legs ten each
